data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Aires is the god of the sky and the champion of justice, war, and courage. He is also identified with the Roman god Jupiter. The name Aires carries the meaning “The God of the Sky” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aires usually hope their child will grow to embody the god of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
